note: Quick, Draw! hammer 6216989498408960, drawn upright: stroke 0 is the left end face of the head, a short vertical line; stroke 1 is the head, a box open on its left side; stroke 2 is the handle, a long narrow loop hanging from under the head; stroke 3 is a single dot where the head's lower left corner closes. The hammer is rigid, so the whole doodle is placed by two points: the centre of the head and the butt end of the handle. The line between them sets where the hammer is and how far it is tilted as the caveman raises it, turns it in his hand and lifts it to his face. Its length is held at one size for the whole shot, measured from the keys.
